single-cluster.description: One cluster at a time on container-local sparse BlueStore, tests run sequentially
single-cluster.basis: Memory is the VM size the suite is sized for (docs/contributing/testing.md). CPUs are those of the hosted CI runner; fewer were not measured. Disk is the 8 GiB image-preparation allowance plus the 4 GiB runtime allowance of the smallest qualified CI storage profile (docs/contributing/ci.md).

in-memory-osds.description: One cluster of up to three 1 GiB WithInMemory (tmpfs) BlueStore OSDs
in-memory-osds.basis: single-cluster plus 3 GiB for three fully allocated 1 GiB tmpfs stores, rounded up to the next common VM size. An arithmetic bound, not a measured peak.

ci-parity.description: A CI batch as CI runs it: two tests at once (CEPH_TEST_PARALLEL=2), multicluster fixtures included
ci-parity.basis: The size of the hosted CI runner and the largest qualified CI storage profile, 8 GiB image preparation plus 8 GiB runtime (docs/contributing/ci.md).

block-fault-delay.description: single-cluster plus the device-mapper delay target that the delay window of the block fault test needs
block-fault-delay.basis: single-cluster. The kernel feature is a property of the engine kernel; no resource value provides it.
